linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.goal: Build authority → drive DMs → book audit calls

best_formats: Text posts with aggressive line breaks

hook_formulas: Contrarian: 'Most law firms believe {common_belief}. Here's why they're wrong.'
Data bomb: 'I analyzed {number} {things}. {percentage}% had the same mistake.'
Story: 'A {client_type} came to us with {problem}. The data was brutal.'
Math problem: 'Your PI firm gets 90 calls/month. 47 go unanswered. That's $4,183/month in the trash.'
Confession: 'I used to tell every law firm to {advice}. I was wrong.'
Before/after: '{Time ago}, {firm} was {bad_state}. Today they {good_state}. Here's what changed.'
Proof-first: 'We took a {firm_type} from {bad} to {good} in {timeframe}.'
post_structure: Hook in first 2 lines (must create information gap before 'see more' cutoff)
One thought per line with aggressive line breaks
End with action steps or engagement question, NOT a sales pitch
80/20 rule: 80% value posts, 20% with soft CTAs
carousel_rules: Slide 1: Bold hook (8 words max, functions as thumbnail)
One idea per slide, max 40 words per slide
Use arrows or swipe indicators on slides 1-2
Final slide: CTA (follow, comment keyword, or save)
post_frameworks: Unpopular Opinion: contrarian claim → evidence → reframed question
Mistake I Made: mistake → cost → consequences → lesson → fix
3-Step Framework: outcome = 3 things → most skip Step X → proof
Before/After: client problem → changes → results → counterintuitive lesson
I Analyzed X: number → surprising finding → breakdown → what winners do
Mini Case Study: client quote → bad metrics → 3 tactics → good metrics → principle
meeting_conversion: Comment-keyword CTA: 'Comment AUDIT and I'll send you the checklist'
Value-first DM: Share resource first, suggest call after 2-3 exchanges
Engage on target accounts' posts for 2-3 weeks before outreach
Profile: headline = 'What you do + Who you help + Outcome'
Featured section: pin case studies, lead magnets, frameworks
Comment on 10-20 target posts daily BEFORE posting your own
Respond to every comment within 1 hour (algorithmic window)

x_single.name: X (Twitter) — Single Tweets
x_single.goal: Start conversations → build following → DM qualified prospects

post_structure: Under 280 chars — most provocative, quotable line
Use numbers and data to add authority
thread_frameworks: I Spent $X Learning This: hook with credibility → lessons → CTA
Strategy Breakdown: analyze how [entity] achieved [result] → their playbook
Tools/Resources Thread: curated list with one resource per tweet
Contrarian Take: bold claim → evidence → rebuttal to objection → conclusion
Case Study Thread: situation → diagnosis → changes → results → lesson
meeting_conversion: Thread CTA: 'Reply AUDIT and I'll DM you the template'
Pinned tweet links to highest-converting lead magnet
DM pipeline: comment engagement → connection → resource share → call offer

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.goal: Build deep trust through long-form → funnel to landing page → book calls

script_structure: Hook (0-30s): Proof (why listen) + Promise (what they'll get) + Plan (structure)
Problem (1-3 min): Agitate pain with specific numbers and scenarios
Content (3-10 min): Framework with concrete lists/stories, mini-hooks between sections
Proof (10-12 min): Case study or data that validates the framework
CTA (last 30s): Single clear action — lead magnet or subscribe
title_formulas: I Spent ${amount} on {thing} So You Don't Have To
The {adjective} Truth About {topic} Nobody Tells You
thumbnail_rules: Human face with clear emotion (surprise, shock, curiosity)
Text in top-left (87% of top thumbnails)
Title and thumbnail complement, never duplicate
Test at mobile size before publishing
retention_techniques: Pattern interrupts every 30-60 seconds (zoom, cut, text overlay, B-roll)
Open loops: 'Later I'll show you the exact strategy...'
Mini-hook at start of each section
meeting_conversion: Description: hook text → lead magnet link → book call link → social links
Pin comment with lead magnet link (more visible than description)
Mid-roll CTA: 'I do free 15-min audits. Link in description.'
End screen: direct to lead magnet or case study video

email.name: Newsletter / Email
email.goal: Nurture leads from lead magnet to booked call

subject_line_rules: Under 50 chars (60% of B2B opens on mobile)
No ALL CAPS, no !!!, no spam triggers
No emojis for B2B law firm audiences
nurture_sequence: Email 1 (Day 1): Deliver lead magnet + one key insight from results
Email 2 (Day 3): Case study showing someone similar who improved
Email 3 (Day 5): Educational content deepening the problem
Email 5 (Day 10): Process reveal — 'here's what fixing this looks like'
Email 6 (Day 14): Direct CTA to book strategy call with value proposition
structure: Subject line: specific number or contrarian take
Opening: one specific insight or story
Close: soft CTA (reply, forward, or book)
meeting_conversion: Meeting ask at email 5-6 (after 3-4 value emails)
Low-friction: 'Would it make sense to chat for 15 minutes?'
Value-justified: 'Walk through {deliverable} — saves firms like yours {amount}'
Reframe: 'Not a sales call. Sharing what works for {practice_area} firms. 15 min.'

short_video.name: Short-Form Video (Reels/Shorts/TikTok)
short_video.goal: Capture attention in 3 seconds → drive to lead magnet or follow

hook_formula: You have 2-3 seconds. 71% decide in first 3 seconds.
Start with unexpected visual or bold verbal claim
Never open with 'Hey guys' or 'In this video'
Text overlay at all times (50% watch without sound)
content_rules.script_30s: HOOK (0-3s): Bold claim → PROBLEM (3-10s): What most get wrong → SOLUTION (10-25s): 2-3 steps → CTA (25-30s): Follow or comment keyword
content_rules.script_60s: HOOK (0-3s) → CONTEXT (3-10s): Credibility → PROBLEM (10-15s): Counter-evidence → VALUE (15-40s): 3 steps → PROOF (40-50s): Result → CTA (50-60s): Save/share/follow
content_rules.script_90s: HOOK (0-3s) → STORY (3-15s): Client scenario → DEEP DIVE (15-30s): Root causes → FIX (30-60s): 3-step framework → RESULTS (60-75s): Metrics → LESSON (75-85s): Principle → CTA + LOOP (85-90s)
pattern_interrupts: Jump cuts, zoom ins/outs, text overlays
Use props: printed report, whiteboard, check
meeting_conversion: Comment [keyword] CTA for DM conversation
Bio link to scorecard/quiz (not generic website)
'Link in bio for the full breakdown'

framework.why_it_works: Humans need personalized feedback. Creates urgency through self-discovery. Collects zero-party data.
pillars_for_legal: Online Visibility (SEO rankings, Google Business Profile)
Intake & Conversion (speed to lead, follow-up process)
Client Retention (referral systems, past client nurture)
Analytics & Attribution (tracking ROI, knowing what works)

pipeline: Step 1: Test idea as tweet/LinkedIn post (cheapest validation)
Step 2: Measure engagement — flag winners for expansion
Step 3: Expand to long-form (blog, YouTube, newsletter)
Step 5: Written derivatives (carousel, quote cards, email snippets)

Day 14: Reshare (80% missed it first time)
